children: Tokyo, September 14, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation's A2 issuer and senior unsecured ratings, and its A2 senior unsecured shelf rating.  "The affirmation of the A2 ratings reflects our expectation that FUJIFILM's highly diversified and unique business portfolio will continue to support stable credit quality," says Shunsuke Kimura, a Moody's Ratings Assistant Vice President.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms FUJIFILM's A2 ratings; outlook stable
